title: PR Generated Artifact Refresh runner-context registration

phases.objective: Restore GitHub planning and registration for PR Generated Artifact Refresh by initializing runner-scoped report paths only after runner allocation.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow planner and pull-request validator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: pull_request or workflow_dispatch event for PR Generated Artifact Refresh
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both read-only artifact evaluation and Work Map recovery activation receive absolute bounded report paths after runner allocation, allowing the workflow to register and emit canonical evidence.
steps: Evaluate workflow triggers and job-level environments without referencing runner.temp.
Allocate the Ubuntu runner for the selected job.
Create a bounded directory beneath RUNNER_TEMP.
Publish absolute REPORT_PATH and REPORT_MARKDOWN_PATH values through GITHUB_ENV.
Run existing exact-head, read-only evaluation or governed Recovery delegation.
Upload evidence from the initialized absolute paths.
assertions: The refresh job initializes both JSON and Markdown report paths after runner allocation.
The Work Map activation job initializes its JSON report path after runner allocation.
The workflow retains read-only repository content authority and no git push path.
No Production, provider, deployment, database, SQL, Migration Apply, credential, protected-ref, force-push, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve existing exact-head validation, generated-artifact read-only evaluation, Recovery enablement and delegation, canonical comments, and bounded Artifact uploads.
Fail regression if runner.temp returns to job-level evaluation or either report-path initialization bridge is removed.
This repository workflow-registration repair has no provider canary authority.
This repair performs no Production action or deployment.
